notes: After T3 the Runner never installed a breaker or contested a remote, spending T4-T7 and T10 clicking for credits up to 23 while the Corp scored Freedom of Information, Tomorrow's Headline and Post-Truth Dividend from Server 2/4. Server 2 sat advanced overnight on T5 and T9 while the Corp had 0-1 credits, and the Runner made repeated R&D runs or took credits instead.

Scored Fujii Asset Retrieval, two Hybrid Releases and Flower Sermon from remotes, but from T7 it ran on 0-3 credits and spent many turns clicking for single credits or drawing. On T10 it put Project Yagi-Uda in Server 2 and left it there half-advanced for two turns, so it was stolen through Diviner on T12.

Installed Boi-tata on T1, then clicked for credits nearly every turn from T3 to T20, reaching 68 credits without installing a breaker for Akhet or Descent. The Corp scored Divested Trust twice from Server 1 (T11, T13) and Above the Law from Server 3/5 with agendas sitting overnight, and the Runner's only runs were facechecks into Descent on T14 and T20 with no breaker.

On T2 HQ had only Drafter, which has no ETR, while Megaprix Qualifier sat in HQ, and it was stolen. Economy hovered at 0-4 credits through T8, but Seamless Launch into Melies (T7-8), the Ansel/Bloop rezzes on T11 and campaign income brought a sensible win via Architect Deployment Test and Megaprix in Server 1.

Good R&D pressure through Ping with Tremolo stole Freedom of Information and Tomorrow's Headline, and Maintenance Access into HQ on T11 won the game. On T3 it wasted Window of Opportunity to derez N-Pot, which the Corp simply rezzed again. Economy stayed at 0-4 credits all game, and on T8 it facechecked Doomscroll, losing 3 cards, though that run stole Post-Truth Dividend.

Stacked four ice on an empty Server 1 (T3-T6) while keeping agendas in HQ behind one unrezzed ice that it never rezzed despite having 9-13 credits. The Runner stole Architect Deployment Test (T6), Melies City Luxury Line (T8) and Megaprix Qualifier (T9) straight from HQ, and the Corp never installed an agenda.

Sharp play: it ran Server 1 when the broke Corp could not rez (Artificial Cryptocrash T2, Next Big Thing T4), used Rigging Up into Nanuq to break Klevetnik, and won through Funhouse/Paywall for Kingmaking on T8. The only minor slack was drawing instead of pressuring on T3.

Reached 5 points by T4 from open R&D, then stopped running R&D and clicked for credits almost every turn from T5 to T22, reaching 63 credits. The Corp scored Transport Monopoly (T11), Divested Trust (T20) and Above the Law (T23) unopposed, and the Runner only facechecked Tree Line (T18) and Envelopment (T19) with no breaker.

Kept installing agendas into Server 2 behind only Bathynomus after the Runner showed it would take the 3 net damage: Longevity Serum (T3), Lotus Haze (T4) and Lotus Haze again (T5, stolen T7) were all stolen. On T8 it put See How They Run behind one Anemone with 4 credits and lost the game, all on a 0-5 credit economy.

Scored Longevity Serum, Regenesis and Sisyphus Protocol in Server 1 and used Personal Evolution and Bladderwort damage for a T7 flatline. It never iced R&D, though the Runner ran it 3-4 times every turn, which gave up Lotus Haze and two Hybrid Releases.

Solid remote scoring of Post-Truth Dividend, Embedded Reporting, Tomorrow's Headline and Embedded Reporting, but it clicked for credits at 8-10 credits on T2-T4 instead of developing. On T8 it put Tomorrow's Headline in Server 1 behind a single ice and lost it through Tsarevna, and the Oppo Research on T10 had no follow-up.

On T3 it installed a second Boi-tata and facechecked Descent on both Server 1 and R&D at 3 credits, then let SDS Drone Deployment sit at 2 advancements on T6 without a run. The later Buzzsaw/Twinning R&D pressure was reasonable and reached 6 points, but it could not get through Akhet on Server 1 on T17 and lost to Transport Monopoly.

After scoring Tomorrow's Headline twice (T10, T13), it clicked for credits every turn from T14 to T24, rising to 66 credits and discarding from a full HQ each turn without installing any agenda or ice. The Runner kept digging R&D through a single Virtual Service Agent until it stole Next Big Thing on T24.

After T8 the Runner made no more runs and clicked for credits from T9 to T15, reaching 42 credits. It ignored naked Server 3 (T11), Hybrid Release in Server 4 (T12-13) and Fujii Asset Retrieval left at 3 advancements overnight on T15, which won the Corp the game.

It made repeated HQ runs on T6-T8 that re-accessed Moon Pool, and on T18 it spent all its money on Vampyronassa/Hafrun boosts, leaving nothing to contest the Fujii Asset Retrieval installed and advanced in Server 2 on T19. It also ignored the fresh Server 2 Hybrid Release on T13 and ran Vampyronassa at 1 credit on T21, though R&D/HQ pressure got it to 6 points.

Scored Melies, Project Ingatan, Superconducting Hub and Architect Deployment Test from Server 2. From T11 to T15 it clicked for credits at 19-32 credits with a 6-card HQ, discarding each turn, and it never rezzed its HQ ice, so the Runner could check HQ freely through T18.

Built recurring economy (Paladin Poemu, Fencer Fueno, Mystic Maemi), installed Buzzsaw for Afshar and hammered R&D, stealing Above the Law, Transport Monopoly and Divested Trust. It won on T7 by trashing Buzzsaw to steal SDS Drone Deployment, and the only questionable run was the T4 facecheck of Akhet on Server 1.

Played Neurospike on T3 with nothing scored, so it did nothing, and kept Project Yagi-Uda in HQ behind never-rezzed ice, where it was stolen on T4. Hybrid Release (T3), Yagi-Uda (T7) and Fujii Asset Retrieval (T10) all went into the already-broken Server 1 on 0-3 credits and were stolen.

Rezzed Ansel on T2 to trash Carmen and kept the broke Runner unable to pay steal costs while scoring Megaprix, Architect Deployment Test and two Project Ingatans from Server 1. Its economy was thin, but Nico/Otto campaigns and Wage Workers covered it, and the T8 multi-advance was efficient.

Facechecked Funhouse at 4 credits on T2 and Grubber at 0 credits on T5, then ran HQ through Funhouse eight times on T6-T7 for repeated Public Trail/IP Enforcement accesses, piling up tags. With no economy, it spent T8-T11 removing tags while the Corp scored Oracle Thinktank twice and Artificial Cryptocrash from Server 3 unopposed.
